title: 4K/8K localized-edit Flow - mask a small region of a huge scene (crop-stitch wiring already shipped)
description: RE-SCOPED 2026-08-09 by the user, after a claim audit found the op-wiring half already shipped. The original card ('every edit model samples the WHOLE frame') is no longer true: InpaintCropImproved -> sample -> InpaintStitchImproved is live in qwen_edit, boogu_edit_balanced, boogu_edit_high, flow_head_swap, and the edit branches inside klein_t2i, krea2_t2i_sfw and krea2_t2i_nsfw. The only live graph still sampling the whole frame is flow_sdxl_regen, which MPI-332 deletes. WHAT REMAINS is the absorbed MPI-347 half, the product outcome the wiring was for: a Flow that masks a small region of a 4K/8K image, edits just that region, and stitches back - the character stays sharp because the crop is sampled at working resolution instead of the whole scene being downsampled to fit. It builds ON the existing wiring; no new engine work is implied. Follow docs/playbooks/add-flow/. STILL TRUE from the original card: crop-stitch is right when the region is surrounded; ImageCompositeMasked full-frame is still needed where the generation must see the whole scene. The original body is preserved in the events log and in the absorbed MPI-347 workspace.
acceptance: Per-model decision recorded: which edit graphs get crop-stitch and which must stay full-frame
Custom-node pack declared as a dep on every path that uses the inpaint classes
Measured before/after time on at least two models
No seam regression - check the stitch gradient, not just wall-clock
